task: Lift the blue barbell with the left arm and place it in the orange tray

subtasks.instruction: Move the left gripper to the center of the blue barbell
subtasks.success_condition: The gripper is aligned around the center of the blue barbell

subtasks.instruction: Close the left gripper around the center of the blue barbell
subtasks.success_condition: The blue barbell is securely held

subtasks.instruction: Lift the blue barbell and move it above the orange tray
subtasks.success_condition: The held blue barbell is above the orange tray

subtasks.instruction: Lower the blue barbell into the orange tray and release it
subtasks.success_condition: The blue barbell rests inside the orange tray

subtasks.instruction: Move the left gripper away from the placed blue barbell
subtasks.success_condition: The gripper is clear and the barbell remains in the tray
